0022600147.text: The Portland Trail Blazers (3-1, 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back) bring a one-game losing streak into their fifth game of the season, having gone 2-0 on the road, and they are without Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), while Ja Morant (hamstring) and Robert Williams III (knee) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. The Utah Jazz (1-4, 5th in the Northwest, 3 games back) have lost three straight and are missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), with Lauri Markkanen (wrist) also day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and Portland won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 124-114 home win on March 13, 2026.
